setting.help: Generate the email signature of every internal user from one template. Users can no longer edit their own signature.

div.div: Placeholders: {{name}}, {{job_title}}, {{work_phone}}, {{mobile_phone}}, {{work_email}}, {{company_name}}, {{company_phone}}, {{company_email}}, {{company_website}}. Unknown placeholders are left as typed. Write one optional line per paragraph: a paragraph whose placeholders are all empty (for example a user without a mobile) is removed entirely, label included. Turning the policy off keeps each user's last generated signature; the original is kept in the user form and can be restored there.
